name: benchmark-trec-covid
description: TREC-COVID is a biomedical information retrieval benchmark created during the COVID-19 pandemic to evaluate systems on retrieving and ranking relevant scientific literature for a set of user information needs. It measures how well models retrieve relevant documents from a COVID-era corpus, using relevance judgments collected from domain experts. The benchmark emphasizes ranking quality for real-world biomedical queries.
reputation: Established community benchmark from the TREC-COVID challenge and widely used in biomedical IR research during the pandemic.
